turns.text: Hello, I would like to return a print. It does not fit the wall I bought it for.
I can help with that. Please send me the order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, so I can verify it.
The order is SC-3528 and the email is samuel.adeyemi@example.com. I know I pay the return postage.

Thank you, Samuel. Your return request for SC-3528 is filed. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and you pay the return postage. Staff must approve the request and the refund before anything is final. We will follow up with the next steps.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
